scope: Major paid, owned and native/performance placement families. Publisher-specific inventory is open-ended; use Open Web/IAB as the interoperable baseline.

update_policy.source_of_truth: Official platform specification URLs in sources
update_policy.change_detection: Firecrawl monitor or the included crawl job compares source pages and flags dimension, media, file-limit, text-policy and safe-zone changes
update_policy.safe_zone_rule: Only pixel values published by the platform are hard. Template/preview guidance is soft and must be rechecked in-platform.

best_practices.meta: Lead with one focal subject, short live copy, high contrast and a clear first-frame benefit. For Stories/Reels keep faces, logos and copy inside the published UI-safe box and preview the account-specific overlay.
best_practices.tiktok: Design for sound-on vertical video, show the product or human action immediately, use native-feeling pacing and captions, and keep critical elements inside the downloadable template—not an invented universal pixel box.
best_practices.youtube: Hook in the first seconds, make the story understandable without sound, use a single action, and provide landscape plus vertical versions rather than relying on an automatic crop.
best_practices.linkedin: Use one professional idea, legible proof, restrained branding and a specific business outcome. Keep carousel cards consistent and avoid dense body copy.
best_practices.pinterest: Make the image useful and saveable, show the product early, use vertical composition and readable branding, and design the first frame to stand alone in a discovery feed.
best_practices.snapchat: Use full-screen vertical motion, fast visual payoff and native captions. Keep all important content inside Snapchat's safe-zone overlay; overlays vary by format and UI.
best_practices.reddit: Lead with a clear, authentic proposition and community-relevant image. Avoid polished generic stock language, clickbait and text that becomes unreadable in mobile crops.
best_practices.x: Put the point in the image and first sentence, use a strong single visual, preserve legibility on mobile and test both feed and card crops.
best_practices.google: Supply a broad asset mix, use uncluttered images, keep text minimal for responsive inventory, and let the platform combine assets while maintaining a coherent message.
best_practices.microsoft: Provide multiple aspect ratios and clean native-looking images; keep the subject obvious at small sizes and avoid important detail near auto-crop edges.
best_practices.amazon: Show the product or use case immediately, keep branding clear, use high-resolution source media and respect the placement's strict file and duration limits.
best_practices.native: Use a truthful editorial thumbnail and headline pairing, one idea per asset, no baked-in CTA where the platform supplies one, and verify the landing-page promise.
best_practices.openweb: Start from IAB standard sizes, keep the message legible at the smallest placement, compress to the publisher byte limit and reserve animation for a deliberate first-frame fallback.
best_practices.owned: Build mobile-first, inline the image or provide a meaningful images-off fallback, keep the destination and copy consistent with the ad, and test dark mode and Outlook/Gmail rendering.
